Compared to the known malicious patterns, it lacks key indicators such as deleting external build environments, anti-sandbox evasion, or obfuscation. malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A legitimate utility package should not install arbitrary dependencies, enumerate user directories, manipulate cryptography libraries, or execute encrypted code at import-time.
